name: StartPos Studio
description: Pick your StartPos on a map, practise parts with a start and an end, place StartPos with one key

prev-startpos.name: Previous StartPos
prev-startpos.description: Goes back to the previous StartPos (wraps around).

next-startpos.name: Next StartPos
next-startpos.description: Goes to the next StartPos (wraps around).

place-startpos.name: Place StartPos here
place-startpos.description: Places a StartPos where your icon is, with the right gamemode, speed, size, gravity and dual already set. It is saved for this level.

remove-startpos.name: Delete the selected StartPos
remove-startpos.description: Deletes the selected StartPos if it is one you placed with this mod.

place-only-practice.name: Place only in practice mode
place-only-practice.description: The place key only works while you are in practice mode.

auto-fix.name: Auto-fix StartPos
auto-fix.description: When you fly through a StartPos, the mod checks your real gamemode, speed, size, gravity and dual there. If the StartPos has them wrong, it fixes them (only for you, the level is not changed).

remember-choice.name: Remember my choice
remember-choice.description: The StartPos you pick before playing stays picked the next time you open the level.

show-hud.name: Info at the top left
show-hud.description: Shows your % and the goal of your part, clicks per second and clicks this try (it goes back to 0 when you die).

progress-markers.name: Marks on the progress bar
progress-markers.description: Draws a small mark on the top progress bar for every StartPos.
